notes.title: Philosopher's Stone Game
notes.notes:
Philosopher's Stone game is a 1Vs.1 turn-based online game consisting of more than 16 different characters, robots, monsters, zombies, animals, vehicles, and humans of all ages, colors, and races.  And there is Philosopher's Stone that was  In ancient Egypt, it was discovered by an Arab alchemist. Each of these characters has a different story. They came together in one game.

These characters are different in movement, attack power, health, special abilities, movement and attack range, and special ability range, and they are  also different in battery consuming for movement, attack, and abilities. So you have to choose your team of characters depending on your playing strategy. You must protect your Philosopher's Stone and destroy the opposing team's Philosopher's Stone to win the game.

The Philosopher's Stone is a legendary substance discovered by an Arab alchemist extracts from it elixir of life that gives eternal life. It is located in ancient Egypt, 
You have to protect it to survive and destroy the opponent team's Philosopher's Stone to win the game.

for more detail visit my website https://fahadgamedeveloper.wuiltweb.com/
